TripAlerts.title: Operational
TripAlerts.subtitle: Live updates regarding routes, border protocols, and fleet operations across the SURA network.

alerts.title: Important route update for cross-border transfers.
alerts.content:
Due to continued road infrastructure upgrades and regional border assessments, all SURA cross-border Driver and self-drive transfers to specific regions are suspended until further notice:

• Goma Border Post (DRC)
• Bukavu Border Post (DRC)
• Select Northern Corridors

While these specific international services are affected, the entirety of the SURA internal Rwandan network, including all National Parks (Akagera, Nyungwe, Volcanoes), continues to operate as scheduled with zero delays. The safety and security of our clients and Drivers remain our absolute top priority.

We are closely monitoring the situation and will provide further updates as soon as more information becomes available. Affected clients may reschedule their itineraries for a later date without penalty.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused. For further assistance or itinerary adjustments, please contact our concierge team at Suraessenceltd@gmail.com or reach out via our 24/7 WhatsApp desk.

alerts.title: Kigali Airport VIP Meet-and-Greet Processing Times
alerts.content: Due to increased seasonal volume, please allow up to 45 minutes for customs clearance upon arrival at KGL. Your SURA Driver will actively monitor your flight status and will wait at the arrivals terminal holding a standardized SURA identification board. No wait-time fees will be incurred for customs delays.

alerts.title: Fleet Luggage & Equipment Restrictions
alerts.content: When booking Executive Sedans, please note that luggage capacity is strictly limited to 2 standard check-in bags. For clients travelling with heavy expedition gear, photography equipment, or excess baggage, upgrading to a Premium SUV or Expedition 4x4 is mandated for your comfort and vehicle safety.

alerts.title: Entry requirements for national parks
alerts.content: All clients embarking on Gorilla Trekking (Volcanoes National Park) or Safaris (Akagera) must ensure their permits are processed at least 72 hours prior to departure. SURA Essence concierge services can handle these logistics on your behalf. Ensure you carry your original passport for all internal transit.

alerts.title: Rwanda Environmental Policy: Plastic Ban
alerts.content: Rwanda enforces a strict nationwide ban on non-biodegradable plastic bags. Please ensure your luggage does not contain polythene bags before arrival. SURA Essence provides eco-friendly refreshment packaging in all our fleet vehicles.

support.title: Require Immediate Assistance?
support.text: If your itinerary is affected by any of the active alerts, our concierge team is on standby to reroute and secure your transit.

intro.title: Kigali Unleashed
intro.headline: Beyond the Hills
desc: Experience the thrill of the thousand hills.
From adrenaline on the mountain peaks to laid-back weekends by the pool.

venues.title: Fazenda Sengha
venues.desc: Mount Kigali's premier outdoor adventure park.
venues.longDesc: Escape the city noise without leaving the city. Fazenda Sengha is an outdoor recreational center located on top of Mount Kigali.

venues.title: Kigali Golf Resort
venues.longDesc: Experience luxury at the Kigali Golf Resort & Villas.

venues.title: Mamba Club
venues.longDesc: Rwanda's first bowling alley and a favorite local hangout.

intro.title: Remembrance
intro.headline: A Tale of Two Eras
desc: We distinguish clearly between Memorials (sacred sites) and Museums (educational).

venues.title: Kigali Genocide Memorial
venues.desc: The final resting place for 250,000 victims.
venues.longDesc: This is sacred ground. It serves as a place for survivors to remember their loved ones.

venues.title: Kandt House
venues.desc: Natural history and early colonial times.
venues.longDesc: Dedicated to Richard Kandt, the first colonial resident.

venues.title: Nyamata Church
venues.desc: A visceral, untouched site of history 30km out.
venues.longDesc: A heavier, deeply moving experience preserving the physical evidence of the tragedy.

intro.title: Urban Pulse
intro.headline: Colors, Crafts & Chaos
desc: Dive into the daily life of Kigali.
From bustling alleys to creative studios.

venues.title: Kimironko Market
venues.desc: The largest covered market in the city.
venues.longDesc: If you want LIFE, you go here. We know the 'mamas' in the fabric section.

venues.title: Inema Arts
venues.desc: Contemporary art gallery & happy hour spot.
venues.longDesc: A beacon for African contemporary art.

venues.title: Nyamirambo Walking
venues.desc: Walking tours through the Muslim quarter.
venues.longDesc: Walk the vibrant streets, visit salons, and enjoy a traditional meal.

intro.title: The Tactical View
intro.headline: Power & Strategy
desc: Understand the military and political history that shaped modern Rwanda.

venues.title: Campaign Museum
venues.longDesc: Located in the Parliament building, this museum details military strategy.

venues.title: Presidential Palace
venues.desc: The former state house near the airport.
venues.longDesc: Known as the Kanombe Museum, this residence is key to understanding history.

venues.title: Rebero Viewpoint
venues.longDesc: A strategic military position in the past, now the best viewpoint for Kigali.
